text: List desk: tile numbers 1-8 are printed on both the back strip and the desk front, and CHECK is labelled; all readable while the crosshair is on tile 5 (prompt 'E: tile 5: make it light'). Check (1) passes for the List desk.

After the first winning CHECK the board highlights a gold diagonal and says the librarian added my row at the top. Clear feedback. Out of time budget before finishing further rounds: aiming at desk tiles costs 1-2 min per tile at this frame rate.
